title: coelogyne alaticallosa
intro: Coelogyne alaticallosa, commonly known as the "Golden Orchid", is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Asia. It is known for its vibrant yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infection. The bioactive constituents of Coelogyne alaticallosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
